title: Diesel engines - Fuel injection pumps - Tapers for shaft ends and hubs
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10478) covers Diesel engines - Fuel injection pumps - Tapers for shaft ends and hubs. Tiiis Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical with ISO 6519 : 1993 'Diesel engines — Fuel injection pumps — Tapers for shaft ends and hubs' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Automotive Primemovers, Transmissions and Steering Systems and Internal Combustion Engines Sectional Committee and approval of the Transport Engineering Division Council. The Sectional Committee decided to align the Indian Standard with the corresponding International Standards recommendation wherever feasible and wherever the domestic considerations were not so intense so as to have standards different from the ISO Standards. This decision was taken with a view to upgrade the quality of the products in line with the International Standards, This standard was first published in 1983. The first revision was undertaken due to revision of the base standard as indicated above. The text of ISO Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as an Ind
clause_3_terminology: Tapers for shaft ends and hubs
